subject: Post-call: BrightForge cost qualification + commitment path
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Brooks <evan@brightforge.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: BrightForge cost qualification + commitment path

Evan — thanks again for the time earlier. Quick recap and next steps so we can get a clean quote into Procurement.

Summary of what I captured from the call:
- Workload: inference + embedding endpoints for document understanding pipelines (no fine-tuning).
- Expected sustained usage: ~18–25M tokens / month initially; spikes up to ~40M in product experiments.
- Latency target: p95 < 350ms for short prompts (<= 512 tokens).
- SLA/Compliance: SOC2 required; will need audit point on retention & VPC options later.
- Timeline: aim to go live with a pilot in 6–8 weeks.

Cost & commercial asks we discussed:
1) A target blended unit at or below $20 per 1M tokens for committed volumes (BrightForge target $/1M tokens).
2) Eligibility for the startup program (they’re seed, raised $4.1M) — asked for credits / introductory runway.
3) Multi-month committed discount path (6mo / 12mo) and any multi-year incentives for a 12–24 month reserved purchase.

What I need from you to proceed: (1) confirm the monthly token range you expect to commit to (pick a low/high band), (2) confirm whether the founders want a multi-year/12mo option, and (3) share the procurement contact who will need the formal quote/MPA.

I’ve attached a blank usage projection and a quick pricing sketch template — Monica will populate a first-pass cost table after you confirm the bands.

Next steps / milestones:
- Evan: reply with committed band (low / expected / high) and procurement contact — by EOD Thu 2/19 if possible.
- Monica: will prepare the pricing sketch and committed-use scenarios once bands are confirmed.
- Markus: follow up with startup program docs and draft MPA template.

Thanks — Markus

--

Thanks Markus — nice write-up. Quick answers inline:

- Monthly token band: low 15M / expected 22M / high 38M (these are inference tokens; embeddings subset ~10% of total).
- Founders are open to 12mo if the unit economics make sense; they'd prefer a 6mo as a lighter commitment.
- Procurement contact: procurement@brightforge.ai (cc’d).

A few clarifying Qs for pricing team:
1) Do your committed discounts tier off absolute monthly tokens or cumulative committed spend?
2) For startup credits — is that applied as a dollar credit or % off the first N months? They’d prefer a dollars-of-credit approach to cover pilot costs.

Sofia — I’ve added Procurement here. We’d like the sketch of the expected monthly cost at current pay-as-you-go and the committed 6mo/12mo scenarios (showing $/1M tokens and total monthly spend for our expected band).

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Evan
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Brooks <evan@brightforge.ai>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@brightforge.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: BrightForge cost qualification + commitment path

Evan — thanks, attaching the first-pass pricing sketch (brightforge_pricing_sketch_v1.pdf) and a sample math summary below. I used the bands you provided (15 / 22 / 38M tokens). Notes: these are illustrative — final quote will include exact token inclusions (completion vs prompt split) and any reserved capacity overhead.

Assumptions: pay-as-you-go (PAYG) baseline = $48 / 1M tokens (hosted inference, standard model family). Committed reductions: 6mo = 18% off PAYG; 12mo = 32% off PAYG. Startup program = one-time $30k credit applied to invoices in first 3 months for qualifying seed-stage companies (credit reduces invoice $ directly). Reserved private deployments / Dedicated are quoted separately.

Scenario math (expected band = 22M tokens / month):
- PAYG: 22 * ($48 / 1M) = $1,056 / month (note: using 1M-token unit; actual invoice rounds by 1M).
- 6mo committed (18% off): unit = $39.36 / 1M => 22 * $39.36 = $865.92 / month.
- 12mo committed (32% off): unit = $32.64 / 1M => 22 * $32.64 = $718.08 / month.

If BrightForge qualifies for the startup credit ($30k applied over first 3 months), that would fully cover the pilot run for the expected band for ~3 years of PAYG at the expected band (i.e., large upfront runway) — practical effect: first invoices show $0 until credit consumed.

Multi-year / larger reserved purchases: we can layer an additional 10–18% off the 12mo committed unit for 24mo prepay or significant upfront token purchase (we’d need a nominal minimum spend threshold to justify that deeper band).

Attachments: pricing sketch includes per-band breakouts for low/expected/high bands and a CSV with projected monthly tokens for Q2–Q4. I’ll prepare a formal quote once you confirm the committed band and whether you want a 6mo or 12mo option included.

Next steps (proposed):
- Evan / Procurement: confirm committed band and preference (6mo/12mo) by EOD Fri 2/20.
- Markus: I’ll prepare the draft quote + standard MPA and share a redline-friendly DocuSign link.

If helpful I included a quick sensitivity: moving from PAYG to 12mo committed at your expected band saves ~32% on unit cost (~$338/month on the numbers above).

— Monica

--
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0221

Request to Redwood: please send a formal quote for a 6-month committed plan at the units above plus the startup credit applied as a $30k one-time credit to be consumed against invoices. Also include a 12mo option in the quote (for board review) and a redlineable MPA. Target internal approval timeline: 2 weeks.

Markus — once we have the quote + MPA link I’ll route to Procurement and the founders.

— Evan
